title: link_layer.py: fragment detection uses hardcoded rule IDs instead of RULE_IDS
description: Same pattern as project-LICHEN-worker6-8lbq (fixed in node.py this round): python/src/lichen/link/link_layer.py lines 1326 and 1329 hardcode (0x78, 0x79) for fragment raw-dispatch detection (guard + error message) instead of the imported/importable RULE_IDS constant from lichen.schc.fragment. The 1328 error message also hardcodes the rule names. If RULE_IDS ever changes (e.g. fragmentation_rule_for_sender picks different bytes), link_layer fragment admission silently diverges from node.py detection and the fragment module. Replace membership checks with RULE_IDS and derive the message text from the constant or keep it stable by policy. Add/adjust regression coverage consistent with node.py's test_fragment_dispatch_tracks_rule_ids_constant.
